```plato

//==
// # Strut distance fields
//
// The bridge from a strut list to a surface: a lattice as a union of capsules,
// which is an EXACT signed distance field (each capsule distance is exact and
// the union of exact fields is exact outside the solid). Marching cubes and the
// sphere-tracing paths therefore consume a lattice with no new plumbing.
//
// Evaluation is linear in the strut count, with no acceleration structure. That
// is the honest cost of the simplest correct form; a caller extracting a large
// lattice should trim the struts to the region of interest first.

// A lattice solid: the union of capsules of one radius around each strut.
// Struts are world-space segments, typically the output of `Struts` in
// `lattices.library.plato`. An empty strut list is the empty solid.
type StrutSdf3D
    implements IValue, ISignedDistanceField3D
{
    Struts: Array<Line3D>;
    Radius: Number;
}
```
